scientific_integrity: Analytic proof covers all admissible real rates and integer indices. Standalone finite rational diagnostics independently exercise identities and boundary cases but are not used as an infinite proof. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent verification, especially an incompletely accessible historical review.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct positive Poisson rates; strict interior high-rate mixing weights. Ordinary global mass log-concavity only. Three or more components and parameter estimation are not classified.
title: A sharp one-sided log-concavity transition for two-intensity Poisson mixtures
